items.summary: CFO recommendation: freeze new monetization claims and discretionary implementation admissions until attribution and cost evidence improve. Amazon data covers 2026-09-21 only: 6,219 clicks, 28 ordered items, 6 shipped items, and $4.92 commission; $4.92 and 629 aggregate clicks are unattributed, so site revenue, contribution margin, ROI, and forecast revenue are unsupported. AI spend is $10.8396 on 2026-10-01 across 11 instrumented sites, while the AI contract covers 38 expected sites; fleet infrastructure, hosting, domain, labor, and other direct costs are absent. Preserve existing capacity and measurement gates; do not treat clicks, impressions, sessions, proposals, or conversions as revenue.

CFO disposition: retain the existing capacity gate and do not admit new finance-impacting implementation work. Before any new affiliate or scaffold work is treated as an investment, require site-level registered tracking IDs, a current revenue window, and direct-cost allocation evidence. No billing, banking, credential, or spend changes are authorized.

Maintain the existing Amazon attribution boundary. Report the 18 named tracking rows separately; retain the aggregate row as unattributed. Do not assign the $4.92 commission or 629 aggregate clicks to any site, and do not publish ROI, margin, payback, or revenue forecasts from them.
